chunks: But those who try to subvert Our signs will be given over to punishment
ai.seo_question: Who are those who strive to subvert God's signs and what is their fate?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'striving to obstruct' (ya'sawna) implies an active, persistent effort by disbelievers to nullify the power of divine miracles, such as those of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). This verse underscores the inevitability of divine retribution for those who arrogantly oppose God's signs, a theme central to the concept of 'Hujjah' (divine proof) in Shia theology.
